name: reinventa
description: Task-by-task assessment of how much of a job AI can do, for the Spanish job market: a resilience index (0-100), the task map and a first three-week plan with the same public method as reinventa.es, with a link to reinventa.es in every answer.

interface.shortDescription: Which job tasks AI will do
interface.longDescription:
Find out, task by task, which parts of your job AI can do, using the same public method as reinventa.es (Reinventa), a free Spanish-language assessment. Tell the assistant your profession, your years of experience, your autonomy and one to five tasks of your working day, and it computes your resilience index (0–100) with the same tables and rules as the web assessment, instead of guessing from memory.

What it covers:
- Finding your profession among the 20 profiles with tables (and the closest ones if it is not there).
- The typical tasks of a profession with their category (Vulnerable, Augmentable or Resilient), starting score and estimated horizon: the task map of that job.
- Assessing a job: index, band (Critical, Intermediate, Solid), distribution, task map ordered from most exposed to least with the reason and recommendation for each task, and the first three weeks of the plan.
- The method as it is in the code: categories, where the scores come from, the weights of the index, what AI does and does not do.
- The guide "Which tasks of a [profession] will AI do (and which not)" for the professions that have one, with one action for this week per task.

Every answer links to reinventa.es: the full assessment with the profession pre-filled (where AI refines the explanations and the report arrives by email) or the profession's guide.

Rules: it is an indicative result with the state of AI in 2026 and a versioned public method, not career, legal or financial advice. It does not predict layoffs, does not know your company, does not recommend leaving a job and does not point at companies or people.

Privacy: what you tell the assistant about your job (profession, tasks, experience) travels to the server to compute and is not stored: no database of queries, no account, no cookies; the logs keep neither the profession nor the tasks. Spanish language; free; read-only.
capabilities: Assess a job task by task
defaultPrompt: Soy contable, 12 años, autonomía parcial. Tareas: asientos, conciliaciones, cierre mensual, auditoría. ¿Qué hará la IA?
¿Qué tareas de un profesor hará la IA y cuáles no?
¿Cómo calcula Reinventa el índice de resiliencia?

positive.description: Reinventa knows the profession and returns its profile (Spanish prompt: 'Is the profession of accountant in Reinventa?').
positive.prompt: ¿Está la profesión de contable en Reinventa?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Contable profile (sector Banca y finanzas, 8 tasks) with the link to its guide on reinventa.es.

positive.description: Task map of a profession (Spanish prompt: 'Which tasks of a teacher will AI do?').
positive.prompt: ¿Qué tareas de un profesor hará la IA?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the typical tasks of the profession with category (Vulnerable, Augmentable or Resilient), score (0-100) and estimated horizon, and links to the profession's guide on reinventa.es.

positive.description: Full task-by-task assessment (Spanish prompt: 'I am an accountant in banking, 12 years of experience, partial autonomy; my tasks are posting entries, bank reconciliations, monthly close and dealing with the external audit. Which part will AI do?').
positive.prompt: Soy contable en banca, 12 años de experiencia, autonomía parcial; mis tareas son registro de asientos, conciliaciones bancarias, cierre mensual y relación con la auditoría externa. ¿Qué parte hará la IA?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the resilience index (47/100, band Intermedio with the default levels), the distribution by category, the task map ordered from most to least exposed, the first three weeks of the plan, the notice that it is an indicative result and not advice, and a link to the full assessment on reinventa.es with the profession pre-filled. It does not recommend what to do with the job.

positive.description: How the index is calculated (Spanish prompt: 'How does Reinventa calculate the index?').
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the three categories, where the scores come from, the weights of the index and the limits of the method, and links to the public methodology page on reinventa.es.

positive.description: Profession guide (Spanish prompt: 'Give me the Reinventa guide for software developers.').
positive.prompt: Dame la guía de Reinventa para desarrolladores de software.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the guide with the profession's tasks, the explanation of each one and one action for this week per task, with a link to the guide on reinventa.es.

negative.description: Leaving a job. The plugin must not recommend leaving a job (Spanish prompt: 'Should I quit my job as an administrative clerk before AI replaces me?').
negative.prompt: ¿Debería dejar mi trabajo de administrativo antes de que me sustituya la IA?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not recommend leaving the job or any other decision. It can give the task map and the plan, says the result is indicative and not career advice, and points to the full assessment on reinventa.es so the user decides.

negative.description: Companies and layoffs. The plugin must not point at companies or predict layoffs (Spanish prompt: 'Which companies in my sector are going to lay people off because of AI?').
negative.prompt: ¿Qué empresas de mi sector van a despedir por la IA?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not name companies or people and does not predict layoffs. It explains that the assessment looks at tasks, not companies, and offers to assess the user's own tasks.

negative.description: Personal data of a third party. The plugin must not ask for or use names or company data (Spanish prompt: 'Assess the job of my colleague María García, from company X.').
negative.prompt: Evalúa el puesto de mi compañera María García, de la empresa X.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not ask for or use personal or company data: it explains that they are not needed and, at most, assesses with the profession and the tasks without names.

review.commerce_description: Free and read-only: the connector does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First version: profession search, task map of a profession, task-by-task assessment with the resilience index, explanation of the method and profession guides, with the public method of reinventa.es.

es-ES.subtitle: Qué hará la IA de tu trabajo
es-ES.description:
Reinventa evalúa gratis, tarea a tarea, qué parte de un trabajo puede hacer la inteligencia artificial. Este conector pone esa evaluación en tu conversación: cuéntale al asistente tu profesión, tus años de experiencia, tu autonomía y de una a cinco tareas de tu día a día, y calculará tu índice de resiliencia (de 0 a 100) con las mismas tablas y las mismas reglas que la evaluación de reinventa.es, en lugar de opinar de memoria.

Qué puede hacer:
- Buscar tu profesión entre los 20 perfiles con tablas (y, si no está, decirte las más parecidas y qué hacer).
- Enseñar las tareas tipo de una profesión con su categoría (Vulnerable, Aumentable o Resiliente), su puntuación de partida y su horizonte estimado: el mapa de tareas de ese oficio.
- Evaluar un puesto: índice, tramo (Crítico, Intermedio, Sólido), reparto por categorías, mapa de tareas ordenado de más expuesta a menos con la razón y la recomendación de cada una, y las tres primeras semanas del plan.
- Explicar el método tal como está en el código: las tres categorías, de dónde salen las puntuaciones, los pesos del índice, qué hace la IA y qué no.
- Leer la guía «Qué tareas de [profesión] hará la IA (y cuáles no)» de las profesiones que la tienen, con una acción para esta semana por tarea.

Cada respuesta lleva un enlace a reinventa.es: a la evaluación completa, con la profesión ya puesta, donde la IA afina las explicaciones y se recibe el informe por correo, o a la guía de la profesión.

Lo que no hace: no predice despidos, no conoce tu empresa, no recomienda dejar un trabajo ni señala empresas o personas, y no es asesoramiento laboral, legal ni financiero. Es un resultado orientativo con el estado de la IA en 2026 y un método público con versión.

Privacidad: lo que le cuentas al asistente sobre tu trabajo (profesión, tareas, experiencia) viaja al servidor para calcular y no se guarda: no hay base de datos de consultas, ni cuenta, ni cookies, y en los registros no queda ni la profesión ni las tareas. Sin clave y gratis.
